commit_message:
[Runtime][WASM] Handle wasm64 pointers in JS completion drains (#25054)

Completion-buffer pointers arrive in JavaScript as BigInts, but
Int32Array expects a numeric byte offset. Passing the pointer directly
throws `TypeError: Cannot convert a BigInt value to a number`.

This converts wasm64 pointers before accessing memory and keeps wasm32
pointers unsigned in the inline and shared-ring completion paths.

Signed-off-by: anutosh491 <andersonbhat491@gmail.com>
name: issue-greeter

commit_message:
[GlobalOptimization] Require output channel reuse for im2col

The im2col control function rejected only convolutions without an
output channel loop, so a depthwise convolution with a unit channel
multiplier, whose output channel loop has extent one, was still
rewritten even though nothing reuses its gathered input. Require an
output channel loop whose extent is not statically one; a dynamic
extent may exceed one and counts as reuse.

Pass the already inferred convolution dimensions to the control
function, so selection uses the same dimensions as the rewrite instead
of inferring them again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>

The im2col control function rejected only convolutions without an
output channel loop, so a depthwise convolution with a unit channel
multiplier, whose output channel loop has extent one, was still
rewritten even though nothing reuses its gathered input. Require an
output channel loop whose extent is not statically one; a dynamic
extent may exceed one and counts as reuse.

Pass the already inferred convolution dimensions to the control
function, so selection uses the same dimensions as the rewrite instead
of inferring them again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Ziereis <ziereis@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[Runtime][WASM] Handle wasm64 pointers in JS completion drains (#25054)

Completion-buffer pointers arrive in JavaScript as BigInts, but
Int32Array expects a numeric byte offset. Passing the pointer directly
throws `TypeError: Cannot convert a BigInt value to a number`.

This converts wasm64 pointers before accessing memory and keeps wasm32
pointers unsigned in the inline and shared-ring completion paths.

Signed-off-by: anutosh491 <andersonbhat491@gmail.com>

commit_message:
[Runtime][WASM] Handle wasm64 pointers in JS completion drains (#25054)

Completion-buffer pointers arrive in JavaScript as BigInts, but
Int32Array expects a numeric byte offset. Passing the pointer directly
throws `TypeError: Cannot convert a BigInt value to a number`.

This converts wasm64 pointers before accessing memory and keeps wasm32
pointers unsigned in the inline and shared-ring completion paths.

Signed-off-by: anutosh491 <andersonbhat491@gmail.com>
name: linux_x64_gcc

commit_message:
[Runtime][WASM] Handle wasm64 pointers in JS completion drains (#25054)

Completion-buffer pointers arrive in JavaScript as BigInts, but
Int32Array expects a numeric byte offset. Passing the pointer directly
throws `TypeError: Cannot convert a BigInt value to a number`.

This converts wasm64 pointers before accessing memory and keeps wasm32
pointers unsigned in the inline and shared-ring completion paths.

Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@6be022066fd2 (#25045)

Adapted to change of ROCDL "wave per eu" attributes type from int to
string in LLVM commit 4d5db577f969 [mlir][ROCDL][AMDGPU] Support string
waves_per_eu for min,max occupancy range (#225663)

The TOSA compliance table has grown beyond what MSVC can support on the
stack.
Apparently, the function size / stack size has been an issue before, see
e.g.:
9e69e851a1f8 [NFC][mlir][tosa] Use optnone for compliance initialization
under ASan (#229292)
1e9bc138d8f3 [mlir][Tosa] Optimize compliance initialization for size to
improve build time (NFC) (#222791)
This change currently adds an experimental mitigation to the LLVM fork
by splitting up the initialization.
    
Claude Code has been used to find the LLVM commits related to the issued
and adapt the IREE side code. The changes have been reviewed manually.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
